description: This Java class `TestInstallUtil` provides static utility methods used during testing and installation processes of the OpenMRS application, such as adding test data, handling test modules, and testing network connections.

classes.name: TestInstallUtil
classes.description: Utility class for testing and installation support in OpenMRS, including adding test data, modules, and network connectivity checks.

methods.name: addTestData
methods.description: Executes a system command to import SQL data into a test database from a specified file path.

methods.name: addZippedTestModules
methods.description: Extracts .omod module files from a zipped InputStream and copies them into the OpenMRS module repository directory.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests if a network connection to a specified URL can be established.

methods.name: getResourceInputStream
methods.description: Creates an authenticated HTTP POST connection to retrieve an InputStream from a URL, encoding credentials as needed.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Helper method to initialize an HttpURLConnection with POST method and timeout settings.

methods.name: encodeCredentials
methods.description: Encodes username and password in Base64 for use in HTTP authentication headers.
